name: Ro20-8065
summary: Ro20-8065 (8-Chloronorflurazepam) is a benzodiazepine derivative with anticonvulsant and muscle relaxant effects, which has been sold as a designer drug.

pharmacology.text: Ro20-8065 (8-Chloronorflurazepam) is a benzodiazepine derivative with anticonvulsant and muscle relaxant effects, which has been sold as a designer drug.

uses.text: Ro20-8065 (8-Chloronorflurazepam) is a benzodiazepine derivative with anticonvulsant and muscle relaxant effects, which has been sold as a designer drug.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Benzodiazepines as a group cause drowsiness, poor coordination, memory problems and slowed reactions. Regular use leads to dependence, and stopping suddenly after heavy use can cause dangerous withdrawal, including seizures.
sideEffects.zh: 人們對它在人體的作用所知甚少。苯二氮平類整體而言會引起嗜睡、協調變差、記憶問題和反應變慢。規律使用會導致依賴，長期大量使用後突然停用可能出現危險的戒斷症狀，包括癲癇發作。
sideEffects.zhHans: 人们对它在人体的作用所知甚少。苯二氮平类整体而言会引起嗜睡、协调制差、记忆问题和反应变慢。规律使用会导致依赖，长期大量使用后突然停用可能出现危险的戒断症状，包括癫痫发作。

fact.en: It is norflurazepam with an extra chlorine atom. Norflurazepam is itself one of the substances the body makes when it breaks down flurazepam.
fact.zh: 它是在去甲氟西泮上多加一個氯原子。去甲氟西泮本身是人體分解氟西泮時產生的物質之一。
fact.zhHans: 它是在去甲氟西泮上多加一个氯原子。去甲氟西泮本身是人体分解氟西泮时产生的物质之一。
